title: A prefix is not a complete handle
hook: Seeing a rule’s right side is only part of deciding when to reduce.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Recognize a handle with parser state before reducing a shifted symbol sequence.

misconception: Any substring matching a grammar right-hand side can be reduced immediately.
objective: Recognize a handle with parser state before reducing a shifted symbol sequence.

claims.text: A reduction replaces a recognized handle with its left-hand nonterminal and consults the goto state. The state and lookahead select that action; reducing arbitrary matching characters without the viable-prefix state can recognize the wrong language.
